contracts.family: All native phases and actual causes
contracts.evidence: Both raw methods admit array view first, then canonical effective storage spelling. record_shader observes shader/uniform/layout/group/pipeline/encoder/record through one infallible context.observe_validation closure; scope drain occurs before Result mapping. Both observe and submit map the actual error into ComputePassError::Native(Arc<actual wgpu::Error>); Error::source exposes it. No early fallible return is inside this observation closure, so no OperationAndObservation wrapper is necessary or missing. First captured SDK Validation cause is retained; SDK scopes do not promise to aggregate every native error.

blit selects source view, then target face view, then observes all raw shader/sampler/layout/group/render-pipeline/encoder/pass commands and calls submit afterwards. Fast copy retains destination presence/device first; exact size/logical format/layer/no-layer eligibility; then source device; its native encoder/copy phase is immediately observed and submit still owns finish/deferred transfer validation. Fallback branch and all copy origins/extents preserved. Native encoder-state errors can be immediate; actual transfer resource validation may remain deferred to finish, so neither is assumed exclusively.

Existing array/face/view selectors and selected-view record are byte-identical. Default/no allocation returns Uninitialized before format lookup; wrong context returns WrongDevice before native creation; same logical cached-view behavior on Texture2d/3d/Cube and missing-view state remains unchanged. Raw generated storage spelling and native StorageTexture format both use effective_format(self.format), consistent with selected array view; unsupported exact format returns StorageFormatError, never rgba32float fallback. Blit render target uses that same effective view policy. No successful native allocation/view or cache entry is published on failed observed rendering.

observe_validation is unchanged and only pushes/pop scopes when native blocking_validation is enabled. It has no poll or completion wait; browser and borrowed paths retain configured device handling and do not provide a synchronous validation verdict. Existing view ValidationScope may retain its prior wait; no additional rendering wait added. Context.submit remains unchanged with separate finish/queue scopes, actual cause retention, no completion promise and no rollback claim.
